risks.risk: The synthesizer may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the synthesizer powered on, with keys being pressed and sound outputting, or a photo of the power indicator lit and a working display.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have missing or damaged keys, or the control panel may have non-functional buttons or knobs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keys and control panel, showing all keys and knobs in detail, with no visible damage or missing parts.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential key or control damage

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit or non-genuine KORG X50.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number or a close-up of the branding and model label, ideally with a comparison to an authentic KORG X50.

proof_requests: Video clip of the synthesizer powered on and playing notes.
Close-up photos of all keys and control panel buttons/knobs.
Photo of the serial number or any authenticity label.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as KORG X50 from photo 2. The seller's claim is supported by visible evidence. Hidden risks exist but are priced at worst case (non-working, damaged, or counterfeit) until proven otherwise. The item can be priced based on its worst-case condition as seen.
